query:
SELECT ix.rel_path AS "index_path!"
        FROM file_measurements fm
        JOIN disc_files df
            ON df.file_id = fm.id
        JOIN discs d
            ON d.id = df.disc_id
        JOIN file_measurements ix
            ON ix.id = d.index_file_id
        WHERE
            fm.data_source_id = ?1
            AND fm.rel_path = ?2
            AND fm.ingest_id = (
                SELECT max(i.id)
                FROM ingests i
                WHERE i.data_source_id = ?1 AND i.success = 1
            )
